name: Python + FastAPI
description: Modern async Python conventions for FastAPI services

rules.title: Use dependency injection
rules.content: Use FastAPI's Depends() for injecting database sessions, auth, and services. Avoid module-level singletons.

rules.title: Type all functions with annotations
rules.content: Every function parameter and return type must have a type annotation. Use Pydantic models for request/response bodies — never use plain dict.

rules.title: Async handlers for I/O
rules.content: All route handlers that perform I/O (database, HTTP, file) must be declared as async def. Use await for all async calls.

rules.title: Use pytest with httpx
rules.content: Use pytest with httpx.AsyncClient for integration tests. Use pytest-asyncio for async test functions. Mock external dependencies with unittest.mock or pytest-mock.

rules.title: Use environment variables for secrets
rules.content: Load all secrets from environment variables via pydantic-settings. Never hardcode credentials. Validate required settings at startup.

rules.title: Follow PEP 8
rules.content: Use snake_case for functions and variables, PascalCase for classes, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for constants. Keep line length under 100 characters.
